summary: This directory defines the structural representation for composite symbol identifiers within the system, specifically enabling the association of unique identifiers with qualified names for enhanced symbol tracking and referencing.
responsibilities: Define the schema for composite symbol identifiers
Provide a unified structure for linking symbol IDs with their qualified names
relationships: The composite symbol identifier combines a unique SymbolId with a qualified name to establish a complete reference for a symbol.
designDecisions: Use of an interface to define the contract for composite identifiers
Composite pattern approach to group related symbol metadata
